items.t: Said she has a role in directing the National Lieutenant Governors Association's support of STEM education and that a Lieutenant Governors' STEM Scholarship for Schools would go to a Kentucky school.
items.q: As part of leadership, I have a role in directing the organization’s support of STEM education and I am happy to say we will soon announce we’ve brought a Lieutenant Governors’ STEM Scholarship for Schools to a school in Kentucky,

record.t: Won re-election as lieutenant governor of Kentucky to a second term, alongside Governor Beshear, in the Nov. 7 election.
record.q: Beshear and his running mate, Democratic Lt. Gov. Jacqueline Coleman, won reelection to a second term in a race that drew considerable national attention.

record.t: Was re-nominated as a South Region at Large Member of the National Lieutenant Governors Association.
record.q: Lt. Gov. Jacqueline Coleman was re-nominated as a South Region at Large Member of the National Lieutenant Governors Association (NLGA) at the organization’s annual meeting Monday.

record.t: Announced she will step down as Secretary of the Education and Workforce Development Cabinet to focus exclusively on her role as Lieutenant Governor.
record.q: Lt. Gov. Jacqueline Coleman announced she will step down as Secretary of the Education and Workforce Development Cabinet (EWDC) to focus exclusively on her role as Lieutenant Governor

record.t: Serves as the 58th Lieutenant Governor of Kentucky.
record.q: is the 58th Lieutenant Governor of Kentucky. She is a life-long Kentuckian, educator, basketball coach, writer and founder of a nonprofit.

record.t: Was announced by Gov. Beshear as Kentucky's Secretary of Education and Workforce Development.
record.q: He started by announcing that Lt. Gov. Jacqueline Coleman, a former public educator and coach, would be Kentucky's Secretary of Education and Workforce Development.

record.t: Announced a run for governor of Kentucky in 2027.
record.q: Kentucky’s Lt. Gov. Jacqueline Coleman (D-KY) will be running in 2027 to replace her term-limited boss, Gov. Andy Beshear (D-KY), as the state’s next governor.
